Killing_gate.condition: beta is Killing and all gauge/response backgrounds are invariant under beta

harmonic_gate.L1: Killing/global-rotation channel; transition susceptibility vanishes in invariant vacuum
harmonic_gate.L2: kinematically allowed non-Killing stress vertex; reduced matrix elements open
harmonic_gate.L3: kinematically allowed non-Killing stress vertex; reduced matrix elements open

relative_core_wall_vertex.required_matcher: a unitary seam identification U_cw between the normalized core and wall spinor bundles on one common domain

single_cap_vertex.coefficient: fixed by the Dirac action; no independent spin-rotation coupling
single_cap_vertex.interpretation: the beta^i T_0i coupling obtained by varying the tetrad and its Levi-Civita spin connection together
single_cap_vertex.spinorial_Lie_derivative: L_beta^K psi=beta^i nabla_i psi+(1/4)(D_i beta_j) gamma^{ij} psi, gamma^{ij}=(1/2)[gamma^i,gamma^j]
